name: 到期管家
description: Track recurring due dates and Apple Reminders with compact widgets, safe completion history, local backups, optional notifications, and checked updates.

localizedDescriptions.en: 2.5.11 changes only the Show Amounts setting icon from a filled banknote to its outline variant. Icon size, color, alignment, other settings icons, widgets and user data remain unchanged.
localizedDescriptions.zh: 2.5.11 仅将「在组件显示金额」的实心纸币图标改为线框式。图标尺寸、颜色、对齐、其他设置图标、桌面组件和事项数据均保持不变。
localizedDescriptions.zh-Hans: 2.5.11 仅将「在组件显示金额」的实心纸币图标改为线框式。图标尺寸、颜色、对齐、其他设置图标、桌面组件和事项数据均保持不变。
localizedDescriptions.zh-Hant: 2.5.11 僅將「在元件顯示金額」的實心紙幣圖示改為線框式。圖示尺寸、顏色、對齊、其他設定圖示、桌面元件和事項資料均保持不變。
